name: Suzhou Anjie Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Suzhou Anjie Technology Co., Ltd. engages in research and development, production, and sales of precision functional devices, precision structural parts, and module products. The company provides adhesives, insulators, buffer, shielding, light shelter, heat dissipation, electric conductors and optical film, touch panel, window protective glass, precision metal parts, new energy vehicle parts, and other products. It also offers consumer electronics products for smart phones, desktops and laptops, tablet PC, smart wearable devices, and smart home products, as well as precision functional devices and various services for new energy vehicles industry.
